# Best Gifts for a Hard-Working Dad Who Loves His Truck


A hard-working dad is the toughest person on your list to shop for. Ask him what he wants and he says nothing. He already has the tools, the boots, and the truck. So you end up buying another tie, another mug, another gift card he forgets in a drawer.


Here is the trick to gifts for a dad who has everything: skip the stuff and give him something he will actually use, every single day, out of the one place he spends the most time, his truck. The gifts below are practical, they are built in the USA where noted, and they turn his truck into something more useful. They make great Father's Day, Christmas, birthday, and Labor Day gifts, and seasonal sales like Labor Day are the best time all year to buy.


## Why a practical truck gift beats another gadget


The best gift for a hands-on dad is one that solves a real problem. Keeps his gear dry. Keeps power on when the grid goes down. Makes hauling easier. Those are the gifts that get used on day one and every day after, instead of sitting on a shelf. Worksport makes five of them, one for every kind of dad.

## For the off-grid dad: the SOLIS solar array


Give him a truck that makes its own power. The[Worksport SOLIS](https://www.worksport.com/products/solis) is a custom fit, folding solar array, basically a solar tonneau cover, that mounts on his truck bed and turns it into a solar generator. It makes up to 480 watts of clean, quiet power while he drives or parks, and it doubles as a hard cover that protects his gear underneath. It is the perfect gift for the overlander, the camper, the hunter, or the dad who just likes being ready for anything. Every SOLIS is 100% assembled in the USA.


Best for: the outdoorsy, off-grid, or overlanding dad. Pair it with COR below for a complete solar generator.


## For the always-prepared dad: the COR power station


A portable power station he will actually reach for. The[Worksport COR](https://www.worksport.com/products/cor) is a modular power system with swappable LiFePO4 batteries, four 120 volt outlets, and 2000 watts of clean household power. It keeps the fridge cold in an outage, runs his tools on the jobsite, and charges everything at camp. When one battery runs low, he swaps in another in seconds. Here is what a single battery can run:


What he plugs in Roughly how long it runs


Refrigerator Up to 36 hours


CPAP machine Up to 15 hours


Wi-Fi router Up to 7 days (about 170 hours)


Power tool batteries Up to 8 or 9 recharges


55 inch 4K TV Up to 8 hours


Phone 60 or more full charges


Estimates based on the COR 960 Wh nominal battery. Real runtime varies with the device and conditions. Add batteries to double or triple these numbers.


Best for: the prepared dad, the tailgater, the jobsite dad, and anyone who hates being caught without power.


## For the dad who loves the newest tech: the NEXUS auto flip-up cover


The newest hard tonneau in the lineup. The[Worksport NEXUS](https://www.worksport.com/products/nexus) is an auto flip-up trifold cover that latches itself on both sides, with no prop rods, so he gets easy full bed access from either side. It has eight latch points, a full perimeter seal that keeps cargo dry, and holds up to 400 pounds of even load. The aluminum is more than 3x thicker than composite covers, and it is backed by a 3 year warranty. This is the gift for the dad who always wants the latest and greatest.


Best for: the gadget dad and the early adopter who wants the smoothest, smartest cover made.


## For the dad who hauls big: the AL4 flip-up cover


When the load is oversized, the[Worksport AL4](https://www.worksport.com/products/al4) flips up for full bed access without coming off. It is a single formed aluminum panel, crossbar reinforced, with aluminum more than 3x thicker than composite covers, advanced EPDM seals that keep cargo dry, and eight latch points that help deter theft. Backed by a 3 year warranty and lifetime support.


Best for: the weekend warrior and the trades dad who is always hauling lumber, tools, or appliances.


## For the everyday driver on a budget: the AL3 tri-fold cover


Clean looks and solid protection at a friendly price. The[Worksport AL3](https://www.worksport.com/products/al3) is a low profile tri-fold with aluminum up to 3x thicker than many composite covers, triple-fin EPDM seals that keep his cargo dry with no drainage rails, and four latch points that help deter theft. It installs in under 45 minutes with no tools and carries a 2 year warranty with lifetime support.


Best for: the everyday commuter and the practical dad who wants a factory-clean look without overspending.

## Frequently asked questions


### What do you get a dad who has everything?


Something practical he will use every day. For a truck owner, that means gear that lives with the truck: a tonneau cover that keeps his stuff dry and hidden, or a portable power station that keeps him ready for anything. Those beat another gadget that ends up in a drawer.


### What is a good gift for a dad who loves his truck?


A hard folding tonneau cover is the classic answer, and Worksport makes three: the everyday AL3, the flip-up AL4, and the auto flip-up NEXUS. For the outdoorsy dad, step up to a SOLIS solar array and a COR power station.


### What is the best gift for an outdoorsy or camping dad?


A solar generator. The SOLIS solar array turns his truck into clean power, and the COR power station stores it so he can run lights, a fridge, and devices anywhere. No gas, no noise, no fumes.


### Are these good Father's Day or Labor Day gifts?


Yes. They ship year round and make strong Father's Day, Christmas, and birthday gifts. If you can time it, seasonal sales like Labor Day are when Worksport's bundle savings are biggest, so it is worth checking current pricing. Many orders also qualify for 0% financing with $0 down.


### Which cover should I get him?


AL3 for the everyday driver on a budget, AL4 for the dad who hauls big loads and wants full bed access, and NEXUS for the dad who wants the newest auto flip-up tech.


## Give him something he will actually use


The best gift for a hard-working dad is not another thing to store. It is something that makes his truck, and his day, work better. Pick the one that fits your dad, and give him a gift he will notice every single time he walks out to the driveway.
